name: Tonari no Maou Tsukai
source:
There is a house, burnt down and left for a long time, next to Haruto's house. One day, two girls come and repair it with magic, and start to live there. They are Sion and Amy. They make trouble involving Haruto....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090305034919/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1005998]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
春斗家隔壁有一栋被烧毁后长期荒废的房屋。某天，两名少女来到这里，用魔法把房子修复一新，并住了进去。她们叫希翁和艾米。两人开始把春斗卷入一连串麻烦……
